relationships.subject: Ro 25-6981
relationships.evidence_quote: Injection of Ro 25-6981 into rostral and caudal ACC of normal rats induced VH and also reversed the analgesic effect of tDCS.

key_findings: NMD reduces ACC GluN2B and neural activity in rats; tDCS reverses this and relieves visceral hypersensitivity, an effect blocked by GluN2B antagonist Ro 25-6981.
